dmitri: Ran the nightly kernel-sweep on mixed-gpu farm. Observed a consistent latency kink around seq_len=96 on SM_86 boxes when the tensorcore BF16 path activates — ~15-22% p99 regression vs last week baseline. Appears to flip kernel path: fast_tc_bf16 -> fallback_fp16_kv.

raj: Can you paste the raw numbers and exact probe command?

maya: Excerpt from /tmp/probe_628.csv and command below. Probe was with KV cache enabled and microbatch=1.
```
./tools/probe_kernels --devices sm86,sm92 --model llama2-7b --seqlens 32,64,96,128 --batch 1 --kvcache=on --format=csv > /tmp/probe_628.csv
# excerpt:
sm86,32,fast_tc_bf16,lat_p50=9.8,lat_p99=30.2,throughput=260
sm86,64,fast_tc_bf16,lat_p50=11.1,lat_p99=35.7,throughput=240
sm86,96,fast_tc_bf16,lat_p50=12.4,lat_p99=48.1,throughput=218
sm86,96,fallback_fp16_kv,lat_p50=12.7,lat_p99=49.9,throughput=210
sm86,128,fallback_fp16_kv,lat_p50=13.1,lat_p99=50.2,throughput=210
sm92,96,fast_tc_bf16,lat_p99=34.4,throughput=260
```

perf-bot: Posted flamegraph + diff to perf dashboard: https://internal.perf/reports/6280007777 (alert level: medium) :bell:

jenna: Two thoughts — 1) KV cache interplay: if prefilling/eviction changes the effective active KV length, kernel decision boundary toggles unexpectedly; 2) microbatch prefetching can create transient kv_hit_ratio drops that cause path flip mid-request. Suggest we gate the fast_tc_bf16 pick with a small hysteresis window and require kv_hit_ratio >= 0.9.

leon: Uploading trace that repros ~20% p99 bump when a microbatch causes a KV eviction at token ~40. Trace ID: trace-628-evict-01 (linked to dashboard).

dmitri: Short patch idea — add a combined condition on GPU capabilities + kv stats before selecting tensorcore fast path. Diff snippet:
```c
// kernel_picker.cpp (concept)
if (gpu.has_tensor_cores && gpu.supports_bf16 && kv.hit_ratio > 0.9 && seqlen <= 112) {
    choose_kernel("fast_tc_bf16");
} else {
    choose_kernel("fallback_fp16_kv");
}
```
This increases the switch point slightly when KV is hot, avoiding flips at 96 for most workloads.

raj: Can we add an autotune unit test that exercises seqlen boundaries with kv_hit_ratio=0.6/0.95 to lock behavior? Otherwise regressions sneak in.

maya: I'll add a test to the autotune-suite and run the dedicated pool canary tonight. If green, will roll to a small canary (10 nodes) and monitor p99 and kv_hit_ratio histograms.

jenna: Also consider emitting a small telemetry flag: kernel_pick_reason = "capflags+kv" so we can query how often kv gating changed the decision historically.

leon: +1 for telemetry. I can add a quick aggregation to the kernel_pick index.

perf-bot: Regression test ticket created: INF-5245. Autotune CI run scheduled for 03:00 UTC.

dmitri: Filing follow-up issue for longer-term: evaluate FP8 path interactions on SM_92/SM_103 in mixed farms — might have similar tipping points. Filing INF-5246. :eyes:

raj: Thanks — keep notes here and paste canary metrics when available. :thumbsup:
